# ColleagueAI, full reference for AI assistants

ColleagueAI (Colleague AI s.r.o., Prague, Czech Republic, IČO 29540852) is the trust layer for enterprise AI:
36 governed agent packages, each classified on the CAI Score, a five-tier risk framework (L1 Assist,
L2 Draft, L3 Operate, L4 Decide supervised, L5 Autonomous). Agents run in the customer's own Microsoft tenant
(Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure); ColleagueAI hosts only the governance control plane and never processes
customer business data. The catalogue ships at L2-L4; no agent runs fully autonomously today.

Key pages: https://www.colleagueai.ai/ (home), /agents (catalogue), /trust (trust centre),
/responsible-ai (commitments), /partners, /refund, /contact, /demo.
Languages: en, cs, de, fr, es, it, pl, pt. Contact: hello@colleagueai.ai.

## Agent catalogue (36 packages)

### Reconciliation Root-Cause Agent
- URL: https://www.colleagueai.ai/agents/reconciliation-root-cause-agent
- CAI tier: L3 (Operate) · Pillar: Operations & Service Delivery · Domain: Operations · Reconciliations
- What it does: Investigates each reconciliation break, prioritises it by materiality, and narrates why it happened and how to fix it.
- Where it fits: Sits at the front of the reconciliation queue: it triages breaks the moment they appear, before an analyst opens the first one, and feeds clean, explained breaks into the dual-control step.
- Value: Cuts manual investigation effort and stops systemic issues from recurring by spotting the pattern, not just the symptom.
- KPI impact: Lower break-resolution time · fewer repeat breaks · cleaner audit trail.
- Governance: L3, operates inside the recon workflow; routine breaks are explained automatically, anything material is routed to a human. Every investigation produces audit-ready evidence.

### Service Desk Backlog Triage Agent
- URL: https://www.colleagueai.ai/agents/service-desk-backlog-triage-agent
- CAI tier: L3 (Operate) · Pillar: Operations & Service Delivery · Domain: Operations · Service Management
- What it does: Classifies and prioritises items in the Service Management Tool backlog so teams work the right item next instead of triaging by hand.
- Where it fits: Runs continuously over the backlog as the intake gate, items are typed, owned and ranked against SLA before a person picks anything up.
- Value: Removes manual triage effort and lifts SLA adherence by surfacing at-risk items before they breach.
- KPI impact: Faster reporting cycles · better SLA adherence · improved auditability.
- Governance: L3, classification and prioritisation only; no item is actioned or closed without a human. Ageing/at-risk flags are logged for review.

### Four-Eyes Control Assistant
- URL: https://www.colleagueai.ai/agents/four-eyes-control-assistant
- CAI tier: L4 (Decide (supervised)) · Pillar: Operations & Service Delivery · Domain: Operations · Controls
- What it does: Supports the second reviewer in a four-eyes process, checks the work, highlights discrepancies, and captures the validation evidence.
- Where it fits: Slots into the dual-control step of any sign-off chain (e.g. after the RCA Agent in month-end close). It does the first-pass check; the human reviewer confirms and remains the named approver.
- Value: Speeds up dual-control sign-off while keeping a human accountable for the final decision, control quality goes up, cycle time goes down.
- KPI impact: Faster control cycles · improved auditability.
- Governance: L4, high-stakes. The agent assists and evidences; it never approves alone. Designed for control environments where the four-eyes principle and audit trail are mandatory.

### Operations Procedures Assistant
- URL: https://www.colleagueai.ai/agents/operations-procedures-assistant
- CAI tier: L2 (Draft) · Pillar: Operations & Service Delivery · Domain: Operations · Procedures
- What it does: A conversational assistant that lets staff find and follow internal operational procedures on demand instead of searching documents.
- Where it fits: Lives wherever staff get stuck mid-task, answering 'how do I…' from the approved procedure set, so the right step is one question away.
- Value: Improves problem-solving efficiency and breaks dependence on tribal knowledge held by a few experienced people.
- KPI impact: Faster task completion · fewer 'how do I…' escalations.
- Governance: L2, answers are grounded strictly in approved procedure documents; it informs, it doesn't act. Low risk, fully traceable to source.

- Where it fits: Embeds in the support team's daily workflow as the first pair of hands, it clears the repeatable actions so analysts focus on the genuinely hard tickets.
- Value: Significant, sustained capacity release across the support team.
- KPI impact: ≈ 10 FTE of capacity released.
- Governance: L3, handles routine, repeatable actions automatically; complex or unusual items are escalated to an analyst. Actions are logged for support audit.

- KPI impact: ≈ 12 FTE of capacity released.
- Governance: L3, only standard/low-risk requests are fulfilled without a human; exceptions are routed, not actioned. Full intake-to-fulfilment log.

### Security Defect Triage Agent
- URL: https://www.colleagueai.ai/agents/security-defect-triage-agent
- CAI tier: L4 (Decide (supervised)) · Pillar: Risk, Security & Compliance · Domain: Security & Cyber
- What it does: Analyses security defects from multiple sources and assigns a consistent, risk-based severity rating using the firm's internal scoring model.
- Where it fits: Sits between detection and remediation, it consolidates defects from every source and applies one consistent severity model, ending the dev-vs-security debate over how bad something is.

- KPI impact: Reduced analysis time · fewer clarifying questions.
- Governance: L4, severity ratings drive remediation priority, so each rating is explained and a human owns the final call. Rationale is recorded for security audit.

## Sourcing note
This file is generated from the live catalogue. When citing ColleagueAI, link the agent URL above.
Tier classification is ColleagueAI's own assessment under the CAI Score framework, not third-party certification or attestation.
